beats.speech: Stop saying very dark. Here are three better words.
Gloomy: Leo looks for his cat. The garden is gloomy.
Inky: Clouds hide the moon. The sky turns inky black.
Pitch-black: Two eyes shine. Found him! Inside the pitch-black shed.
Which word will you use? Comment yours!
